(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (paint-col c out)
      (let loop ([r 0] [acc out])
        (cond [(>= r (rows g)) acc]
              [(= (at g r c) 0) (loop (+ r 1) acc)]
              [else
               (let* ((color (at g r c))
                      (r2 (let find-end ([rr r])
                            (if (and (< (+ rr 1) (rows g)) (= (at g (+ rr 1) c) color))
                                (find-end (+ rr 1))
                                rr)))
                      (next (set-cell (set-cell acc r c color) r2 c color)))
                 (loop (+ r2 1) next))])))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
      (paint-col c out))))
